descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
At Life is Hard , we build our own software products that help digitize the insurance ecosystem in Romania. Our solutions are used every day by insurance brokers and other market participants to simplify operations, improve efficiency and deliver better customer experiences.
 We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, improving existing systems and shaping how software products evolve from a technical perspective. This is a hands-on engineering role with impact beyond writing code. You'll contribute to product decisions with technical insights, help evolve our software architecture and raise engineering standards across the team. You'll work on established, business-critical products where scalability, maintainability and reliability matter, while helping us progressively modernize the technology behind them.
 What you’ll do: 
 Product Development Contribution
Actively participate in all phases of product development by providing technical insights
Proposing innovative solutions that drive product growth and align with business objectives
 Code Optimization
Refactor and optimize existing code to enhance performance, reliability, and scalability
Minimize technical debt and improve maintainability throughout the application stack
 Continuous improvement
Champion ongoing improvements in development processes, security practices, and coding standards across the software lifecycle
Identify and evaluate opportunities to leverage AI technologies in existing products and development workflows, contributing to their practical implementation to improve efficiency, functionality, and user experience
Facilitate knowledge sharing within the team, advocate best practices, and stay updated with emerging technologies and frameworks to foster a culture of continuous improvement 
 Software Architecture and Application Development
Define and implement a modular architecture that supports the seamless integration of functionalities independent of the core application, increasing flexibility and adaptability within the system
Establish and maintain standardized communication protocols between new modules and the core application to ensure compatibility, scalability, and interoperability
Develop new features and applications using a systematic and scalable approach, emphasizing modular design principles to ensure long-term extensibility and strict compliance with architectural standards 
 What we're looking for: 
 Advanced Programming Skills
Strong expertise in PHP (Laravel, Symfony)
Design and implement responsive and adaptive interfaces for cross-platform compatibility, focusing on user-centered design and usability
 API, Microservices, and Database Design
Deep understanding of API design principles and RESTful service architecture to ensure robust communication and data flow
Proficiency in microservices-based architecture, encompassing principles of decoupling, domain-driven design, and API gateways for efficient resource management
Design and manage efficient MySQL database schemas to meet business needs, using indexing, query optimization, and other performance enhancement techniques
 Performance Optimization
Skilled in system performance tuning, including caching strategies, query optimization, and load balancing for enhanced application efficiency and responsiveness
 Message-Driven Architecture
Familiarity with message-driven architectures, including RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, or similar tools, for scalable, asynchronous communication
 Testing and Quality Assurance
Proficiency with PHPUnit for automated unit and integration testing, ensuring code quality and adherence to SOLID principles
Experience in end-to-end testing and proficiency with Postman for API testing
Knowledge of secure coding practices, vulnerability assessments, and implementation of security features across all layers of the application stack
 DevOps and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD)
Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, leveraging tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions to support rapid, reliable software releases
 Containerization Knowledge
Hands-on experience with Docker to facilitate streamlined development, testing, and deployment processes, enhancing consistency across environments
 Front-end knowledge is a plus
Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as Vue.js or Angular
Familiarity with JavaScript, HTML5, SASS and CSS
Understanding of responsive web applications and cross-platform compatibility
 Bonus points if you... 
Have experience in Insurance or InsurTech
Have worked on complex B2B or enterprise software products
Have experience modernizing large or legacy applications while keeping business critical systems running
Have hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features, services, or tools into existing software products or development workflows
Have contributed to architectural decisions across multiple applications or services
 🎁 What We Offer: 
 We believe in building more than products — we build careers.
 • Competitive salary
 • Comprehensive benefits package
 • Private medical insurance
 • Flexible working hours
 • Birthday leave 🎉
 • Opportunities to grow & build meaningful connections
 • Flexible collaboration options, including B2B contract
 Send your CV to: work@lifeishard.ro
